cancellation_policy = """# Travel Cancellation Policy

## Overview
This document outlines the cancellation policy for hotel reservations, car rental reservations, and packaged travel bookings managed by our travel company.

---

## Hotel Reservations

| Cancellation Window               | Fee / Refund                                      |
|------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| **More than 72 hours before check-in** | Full refund – no cancellation fee                  |
| **24–72 hours before check-in**        | 1-night charge as cancellation fee; remainder refunded |
| **Less than 24 hours before check-in** | No refund (full stay charged)                      |
| **No-show**                            | Full stay charged; no refund                       |

---

## Car Rental Reservations

| Cancellation Window                    | Fee / Refund                                       |
|-----------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **More than 48 hours before pick-up**   | Full refund – no cancellation fee                   |
| **24–48 hours before pick-up**          | 1-day rental charge as cancellation fee; remainder refunded |
| **Less than 24 hours before pick-up**   | No refund (full rental period charged)              |
| **No-show**                             | Full rental period charged; no refund               |

---

## Packaged Travel Bookings

Packaged bookings (bundles of hotel + car rental + optional extras) follow these rules:

| Cancellation Window                     | Fee / Refund                                        |
|------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| **More than 7 days before trip start**   | Full refund minus a flat administrative fee           |
| **3–7 days before trip start**           | 50% refund of total package price                    |
| **Less than 3 days before trip start**   | No refund                                            |

---

## Modification Policy

- **Changes to dates or duration** may be treated as a cancellation + re-booking and are subject to the cancellation fees above, plus any rate difference.
- **Upgrades** (e.g., room type, vehicle class) can typically be made without a cancellation fee, subject to availability and the price difference.

---

## How to Cancel

1. Look up your reservation using your booking reference number.
2. Review the applicable cancellation fee for your reservation type and timing.
3. Confirm the cancellation. A confirmation notice and any applicable refund details will be provided.

---

## Important Notes

- All times are based on the **local time zone** of the hotel or car rental pick-up location.
- Refunds are processed to the original payment method and may take 5–10 business days.
- Travel insurance (if purchased) may cover cancellation fees — check your policy for details.
- Group bookings or special-rate reservations may have different cancellation terms as specified at the time of booking.

---

*Last updated: 2025*
"""

# Travel Cancellation Policy
        
        ## Overview
        This document outlines the cancellation policy for hotel reservations, car rental reservations, and packaged travel bookings managed by our travel company.
        
        ---
        
        ## Hotel Reservations
        
        | Cancellation Window               | Fee / Refund                                      |
        |------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
        | **More than 72 hours before check-in** | Full refund – no cancellation fee                  |
        | **24–72 hours before check-in**        | 1-night charge as cancellation fee; remainder refunded |
        | **Less than 24 hours before check-in** | No refund (full stay charged)                      |
        | **No-show**                            | Full stay charged; no refund                       |
        
        ---
        
        ## Car Rental Reservations
        
        | Cancellation Window                    | Fee / Refund                                       |
        |-----------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
        | **More than 48 hours before pick-up**   | Full refund – no cancellation fee                   |
        | **24–48 hours before pick-up**          | 1-day rental charge as cancellation fee; remainder refunded |
        | **Less than 24 hours before pick-up**   | No refund (full rental period charged)              |
        | **No-show**                             | Full rental period charged; no refund               |
        
        ---
        
        ## Packaged Travel Bookings
        
        Packaged bookings (bundles of hotel + car rental + optional extras) follow these rules:
        
        | Cancellation Window                     | Fee / Refund                                        |
        |------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
        | **More than 7 days before trip start**   | Full refund minus a flat administrative fee           |
        | **3–7 days before trip start**           | 50% refund of total package price                    |
        | **Less than 3 days before trip start**   | No refund                                            |
        
        ---
        
        ## Modification Policy
        
        - **Changes to dates or duration** may be treated as a cancellation + re-booking and are subject to the cancellation fees above, plus any rate difference.
        - **Upgrades** (e.g., room type, vehicle class) can typically be made without a cancellation fee, subject to availability and the price difference.
        
        ---
        
        ## How to Cancel
        
        1. Look up your reservation using your booking reference number.
        2. Review the applicable cancellation fee for your reservation type and timing.
        3. Confirm the cancellation. A confirmation notice and any applicable refund details will be provided.
        
        ---
        
        ## Important Notes
        
        - All times are based on the **local time zone** of the hotel or car rental pick-up location.
        - Refunds are processed to the original payment method and may take 5–10 business days.
        - Travel insurance (if purchased) may cover cancellation fees — check your policy for details.
        - Group bookings or special-rate reservations may have different cancellation terms as specified at the time of booking.
        
        ---
        
        *Last updated: 2025*
